summary: DAY structural pass covers the complete 12-company active batch using cumulative company evidence. The lane distinguishes present causal support from future falsifiers. No canonical causal graph was mutated. Each company has a reproducible need→infrastructure→technology/resource→company thesis frame sufficient for Chief causal adjudication; commercial/economic gaps owned by underwriting remain separate unless they break causal relevance.

companies.causalMap: space access/observation need → launch cadence + spacecraft systems → integrated launch/space-systems supplier → RKLB
falsifiers: sustained inability to scale launch cadence or convert systems demand
competitor reusable-launch economics structurally erase addressable niche

companies.causalMap: compute/intelligence demand → accelerated data-center infrastructure → GPUs/interconnect/software ecosystem → NVDA
falsifiers: material workload migration to substitutes with durable lower total cost
ecosystem switching costs collapse

companies.causalMap: heterogeneous compute demand → CPU/GPU accelerators → advanced-node silicon + software → AMD
falsifiers: accelerator ecosystem fails to sustain workload adoption
persistent economics disadvantage versus incumbent/custom silicon

companies.causalMap: digitization/AI demand → leading-edge fabrication → process technology + fab capacity → TSM
falsifiers: credible leading-edge substitute reaches comparable yield/scale
major geographic interruption destroys accessible capacity

companies.causalMap: leading-edge compute demand → semiconductor scaling → EUV/High-NA lithography → ASML
falsifiers: commercially scalable non-EUV patterning substitute displaces leading-edge lithography economics

companies.causalMap: energy-efficient ubiquitous compute → CPU architecture/IP → licensed instruction/core ecosystem → ARM
falsifiers: RISC-V or proprietary architectures materially erode royalty-bearing design share without offsetting value capture

companies.causalMap: AI/data growth → memory bandwidth/storage hierarchy → DRAM/HBM/NAND capacity → MU
falsifiers: structural oversupply destroys returns across cycle
substitute memory architectures bypass MU's scalable product position

companies.causalMap: distributed AI compute → high-speed data-center networking → Ethernet switching/software → ANET
falsifiers: white-box/custom fabrics commoditize control/software value
AI clusters structurally migrate away from Ethernet at scale

companies.causalMap: AI model/inference demand → GPU cloud capacity → power/datacenter/GPU clusters → NBIS
falsifiers: capacity build economics fail to cover capital cost
hyperscalers/internal capacity structurally displace merchant GPU-cloud demand

companies.causalMap: persistent geospatial awareness → satellite observation + analytics → constellation/data platform → PL
falsifiers: commodity imagery pricing erodes value without analytics offset
constellation refresh economics become unsustainable

companies.causalMap: reliable low-carbon power need → advanced nuclear generation/fuel cycle → compact fast-reactor deployment → OKLO
falsifiers: licensing or fuel constraints prevent commercial deployment at economic scale
alternative firm-power solutions dominate delivered cost/reliability

companies.causalMap: compute demand + digital-asset security → power-dense datacenters → mining/AI compute infrastructure → BTDR
falsifiers: AI-cloud build fails to earn cost of capital while mining economics deteriorate
leverage prevents adaptation between workloads

contradictions: NBIS/BTDR exposure to AI infrastructure does not by itself establish durable value capture; structural relevance and underwriting economics must remain separate.
OKLO's strong power-demand causal case does not substitute for commercial licensing/offtake evidence.
unknowns: Timing of successor bottlenecks is inherently uncertain and is treated as falsifiable future state, not current gating evidence.
peerRequests: Chief: keep causal readiness separate from underwriting readiness for NBIS/OKLO/BTDR.
Beta discovery/red-team: challenge substitute pathways for Ethernet, merchant GPU cloud, advanced nuclear and commercial imagery.
